name: Question 8
worked_solution:
We first need to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder parts, which we can do using synthetic division.

We draw up a synthetic division table:

$$
\begin{aligned} & {x}^{3} & {x}^{2} & {x}^{1} & {x}^{0} \\ 3 & 3 & -9 & 1 & -1 \\  & ↓ & 9 & 0 & 3 \\  & 3 & 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}
$$

So from the synthetic division, we get that

$$
\frac{3{x}^{3}-9{x}^{2}+x-1}{x-3}=3{x}^{2}+1+\frac{2}{x-3}.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3{x}^{3}-9{x}^{2}+x-1}{x-3}\,\text{d}x & =\int (3{x}^{2}+1+\frac{2}{x-3})\text{d}x \\  & =3\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x+\int \text{d}x+2\int \frac{1}{x-3}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={x}^{3}+x+2\operatorname{ln}⁡|x-3|+C.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 8
?

Calculate ∫3x3−9x2+x−1x−3dx.

a
x3−9x2+x+ln⁡|x−3|+C
b
13x3−3x2+2x−ln⁡|x−3|+C
c
13x3−3x−2ln⁡|x−3|+C
d
13x3−92x2+12x−3ln⁡|x−3|+C
e
x3+x+2ln⁡|x−3|+C
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We first need to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder parts, which we can do using synthetic division.

We draw up a synthetic division table:

x3x2x1x033−91−1↓9033012

So from the synthetic division, we get that

3x3−9x2+x−1x−3=3x2+1+2x−3.

Therefore,

∫3x3−9x2+x−1x−3dx=∫(3x2+1+2x−3)dx=3∫x2dx+∫dx+2∫1x−3dx=x3+x+2ln⁡|x−3|+C.
